summary.zh: 本期关注两类候选判别：用常规肽段检验非参考序列的独特性，以及用多智能体框架重排小分子结构候选。二者都强调候选之间的比较，但统计验证仍需与模型输出分开。
summary.en: Two approaches examine competing interpretations: challenging non-reference peptide sequences with canonical alternatives, and reranking small-molecule structures through a multi-agent framework. Both compare candidates, while statistical validation must remain distinct from model output.

en: Two approaches examine competing interpretations: challenging non-reference peptide sequences with canonical alternatives, and reranking small-molecule structures through a multi-agent framework. Both compare candidates, while statistical validation must remain distinct from model output.

Accessible journal listings, publication metadata and indexes covered proteomics, small molecules and lipids, ion mobility, imaging and signal processing. Some publisher and preprint articles were inaccessible; the interpretations below retain explicit abstract-level and validation limits.

papers.title: TransPepMS: A Tool to Verify Peptides Absent from Reference Proteomes

publication_status.zh: 预印本，未经同行评审；依据当前存档摘要，修订日期未单独核实
publication_status.en: Preprint, not peer-reviewed; current deposited abstract, revision date not independently verified

read_scope.zh: bioRxiv 提交至 Crossref 的当前摘要、完整作者及首次发布日期元数据；未读全文或补充材料，未复现。
read_scope.en: Current bioRxiv-deposited Crossref abstract, complete authors and first-posted metadata; full text and supplements not read, no reproduction.

commentary.zh: TransPepMS将非参考蛋白组肽段与同质量的常规肽段竞争，为候选给出保留、未决或拒绝判断；摘要报告1,154条已报道拼接肽中53条通过该竞争，同时保留91/99条胰岛素加标杂合肽并排除46条植入的常规肽。对研发的价值在于把“谱图匹配”与“序列独特性证据”分开，但保留53条不等于确认53条真实拼接事件，这些受控挑战也不构成全局FDR保证，算法细节和泛化仍需全文核验。
commentary.en: TransPepMS challenges non-reference peptide assignments with same-mass canonical alternatives and labels them retained, unresolved or rejected; its abstract reports 53 of 1,154 reported spliced peptides retained, 91 of 99 insulin-spike hybrids retained and 46 planted canonical peptides rejected. The method highlights the distinction between a spectral match and unique sequence evidence, but retention does not prove 53 true splicing events and these challenge sets do not establish global FDR control; details and generalization require full-text assessment.

papers.title: MS2Agent: Multi-Agent LLM-Driven Cross-Modal Alignment for Tandem Mass Spectrometry Structural Annotation

read_scope.zh: 出版商存入 Crossref 的摘要与元数据；未读全文或复现
read_scope.en: Publisher-deposited abstract and metadata in Crossref; full text and reproduction not assessed

commentary.zh: MS2Agent 将谱图与分子结构转为文本，通过四类智能体完成表征、候选初始化与协同重排序；在 CASMI 2022 中，同一基础大语言模型的 Recall@1 从 Codex 基线的 0.156 提高至 0.738，为小分子结构注释提供了可组合的推理框架。摘要还报告了 MassSpecGym、异构体及真实样本测试，但候选集合构建、数据切分独立性及潜在训练数据重叠仍需全文核验，现阶段不宜将基准提升直接等同于未知代谢物的可靠鉴定。
commentary.en: MS2Agent converts spectra and molecular structures into text and uses four agent roles for representation, candidate initialization and collaborative reranking; with the same base language model, CASMI 2022 Recall@1 rises from the Codex baseline of 0.156 to 0.738, suggesting a modular reasoning approach to small-molecule annotation. The abstract also reports MassSpecGym, isomer and real-sample tests, but candidate construction, split independence and possible training-data overlap require full-text scrutiny before extrapolating the benchmark gain to reliable identification of unknown metabolites.
